overview: The commission approved the 2023 election calendar and finalized its departmental mission statement. Members also reviewed administrative updates concerning the annual census, departmental staffing, and website improvements.

items.title: Minutes and Agenda Review
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the January 18, 2023 meeting.

items.title: 2023 Election Calendar Approval
items.summary: Approved the standard 2023 election calendar for submission to the City Council.

items.title: Draft Mission Statement
items.summary: Decided to retain the existing website description as the commission's guiding statement rather than drafting a new formal mission statement.

items.title: Tabled Business
items.summary: Tabled the discussion regarding the 2023 caucus and the response to City Council Resolution 23-026 until the next meeting following a procedural dispute.

items.title: Website and Administrative Updates
items.summary: The commission reviewed the updated department website and requested feedback on its new layout and content.

items.title: Election Manager Updates
items.summary: The Manager reported that one-third of the annual census has been returned, announced upcoming cybersecurity continuity training with the state, and noted that ARPA funds were used to purchase additional poll pads.

items.title: Department Staffing
items.summary: Received an update on the internal hiring process for the Head Clerk position and the planned posting of a senior clerk role.

items.title: Correspondence from the State
items.summary: Reviewed state updates regarding accessible vote-by-mail programs and planned technical upgrades to the state voter registration system.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Eunice Browne requested the restoration of historical campaign finance reports to the website and suggested better publicity for census drop-box locations.
